title: Integrity checking of NAS signalling messages in the AMF

entities.name: Integrity checking of NAS signalling messages
entities.description: Procedure for handling NAS message integrity verification in the AMF, including exceptions for unprotected messages and actions when integrity checks fail.

entities.name: IDENTITY RESPONSE
entities.description: NAS message used to provide identity information, accepted without integrity protection when SUCI is requested.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE REJECT
entities.description: NAS message rejecting security mode setup, accepted without integrity protection.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message initiating deregistration, accepted without integrity protection in certain cases.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message for registration procedures, may be sent without integrity protection in specific scenarios.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message for service initiation, processed even if integrity check fails under certain conditions.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message for control plane service initiation, processed even if integrity check fails under certain conditions.

entities.name: Additional 5G security information
entities.description: IE included in SECURITY MODE COMMAND with RINMR bit set to request retransmission of initial NAS message.

entities.name: Secure exchange of NAS messages established
entities.description: Condition indicating that NAS security context is active and secure message exchange is enabled.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state where UE is deregistered from the network.

entities.name: Discard unprotected messages after security established
entities.description: Behavior where AMF discards NAS messages that are not integrity protected after secure exchange is established.

relations.description: IDENTITY RESPONSE message may be accepted without integrity protection when SUCI is requested.
SECURITY MODE REJECT message may be accepted without integrity protection.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message may be accepted without integrity protection in specific cases.
Integrity checking procedure requires secure exchange to be established for processing protected messages.
Once secure exchange is established, unprotected messages are discarded.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND includes Additional 5G security information IE when integrity check fails for REGISTRATION REQUEST.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST may lead to transition to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state, but AMF may remain in 5GMM-REGISTERED if integrity fails.
SERVICE REQUEST processing depends on UE being in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST processing depends on UE being in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
